news.title: WoW Forever Warlocks Are Fighting Back Against Players Who Exploit Them
news.description: Tired of being kicked after summoning? WoW Forever's new addon helps Warlocks expose repeat offenders and fight back!

news.title: How to Unlock Onyxia’s Lair in WoW Forever Ready for December 9
news.description: Learn how to complete Onyxia's attunement in WoW Forever and get your Drakefire Amulet before raids open on December 9.

news.title: WoW Forever Hunters Have New Rare Pets to Track Down in Riverglades
news.description: There are so many new and rare pets to tame in WoW Forever, including 3 in the Riverglades zone. Ombassa, Trapclaw, and Ghostmaw are the most sought-after.

news.title: These Two Faction-Based Weapons Are Worth Hunting Down in WoW Forever
news.description: WoW Forever has plenty of unique weapons for players to track down, but two faction-based rewards are worth adding to your collection.

news.title: Class Tuning, Legacy Improvements, Class Mount Fixes: WoW Forever Hotfixes, November 25th
news.description: A large batch of hotfixes arrives today, with class changes in addition to the Druid ones, Alterac Valley improvements, and much more!

news.title: This Level 1 Ring Has Level 25+ Stats in WoW Forever, But Only Alliance Can Get It
news.description: WoW Forever players can get a ring that has no level requirement and some pretty amazing stats, but only for Alliance.

news.title: (Updated) Harder Mobs, More Focus on Objectives: Alterac Valley Tuning, November 25th
news.description: Alterac Valley is getting some major adjustments aimed at making players play the objectives more, and buffing enemy difficulty.

news.title: This Quest Makes the Run to Mount Hyjal in WoW Forever Much Easier
news.description: Darkwhisper Gorge's elites makes getting to Hyjal rough, but a Winterspring quest gives potions that cut aggro range. Here's how to get them.
